author: Retro Game Corps
description:
In a sea of recent dual-screen handheld releases, the Retroid Pocket Duo is my favorite for actual dual-screen gaming, and here is why.

Retroid Pocket Duo: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-RPDuo
use code "DUO" for $20 off until 30 October

RP Duo impressions: https://youtu.be/ETq7F9KvuQg
RP Duo Lite review: https://youtu.be/kwWHEGWDK94
Anbernic RG DDS video: https://youtu.be/J-RIMA10yU4

WatermelonDS: https://github.com/SapphireRhodonite/WatermelonDS/releases
Dual screen guide: https://retrogamecorps.com/2025/10/27/dual-screen-android-handheld-guide/
Frontend showcased in this video: https://github.com/inssekt/CocoonFE
Adreno 722 drivers (autotune version works best): https://github.com/sherft2607/turnip-adreno722-duo/releases/tag/v1.0.0-T30-a722

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.

Check out my weekly newsletter: http://news.retrogamecorps.com/
